items.title: Gordon Lorraine — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Ken Kimery is identified as the recording engineer/interviewer assistant in the transcript metadata and interviewer introduction, with no personal or professional relationship described between him and Lorraine Gordon in the interview content.

ctx.x: Interviewer: Anthony Brown with recording engineer Ken Kimery Description: Transcript. 43 pp.

Today is July 7, 2012, and this is the Smithsonian Jazz Oral History Interview with NEA Jazz Master Lorraine Gordon, in her home in New York City. It happens to be a very hot but beautiful day in New York. Good afternoon, Lorraine Gordon!
